Join the Sereia Official Affiliate Program – Where Elegance Meets Opportunity!


✨ About the Brand:

Sereia Official is a luxury fashion jewelry brand inspired by the bold elegance of 1980s Los Angeles. Our pieces combine timeless design with the finest materials, including 925 sterling silver, freshwater pearls, and semi-precious stones, all handcrafted to perfection.


💎 What Makes Us Unique:


  • Each purchase comes with a complimentary signature perfume, adding a special touch your audience will love!

  • Our jewelry is made for women who embrace confidence, sophistication, and self-expression.

  • Premium quality at an accessible price point — perfect for creating high-conversion content.



🎥 Content Ideas for Affiliates:


  • Unboxing videos showcasing the luxurious packaging and included perfume.

  • Styling tips featuring how to wear our jewelry for day-to-night looks.

  • Testimonials highlighting the exceptional craftsmanship and material quality.

  • “Perfect Gift” content for birthdays, anniversaries, and holidays.

  • Reels/Stories showing the scent reveal of our exclusive perfume.

Sereia Affiliate Program - Terms and Conditions

1. Introduction

Welcome to the Sereia Affiliate Program. By signing up as an affiliate, you agree to the terms and conditions outlined below. These terms govern your participation in the program and define our respective rights and obligations.

2. Eligibility

To join the Sereia Affiliate Program, you must be at least 18 years old and have a valid payment method for receiving commissions. Sereia reserves the right to approve or reject any application at its sole discretion.

3. Commission and Payment

  • Affiliates earn a 10% commission on each successful sale generated through their unique affiliate link.
  • Payments will be made every 30 days, provided that the affiliate has met the minimum payout threshold.
  • Commissions are calculated based on the net sale amount, excluding shipping, taxes, and discounts.
  • Payments will be processed through the payment method provided by the affiliate.
  • If a customer requests a refund, the corresponding commission will be deducted from the affiliate’s account.

4. Affiliate Responsibilities

  • Affiliates may promote Sereia’s products through social media, blogs, websites, and other approved marketing channels.
  • Affiliates must not engage in misleading or deceptive marketing practices.
  • Affiliates must comply with all applicable laws and regulations, including but not limited to FTC guidelines on affiliate marketing disclosures.
  • Content Requirement: Every approved affiliate must post a minimum of four (4) Instagram Stories per month 1 post / reels for at least two (2) consecutive months. Alternatively, affiliates may choose to post two (2) TikTok videos per month instead for at least two (2) consecutive months.
  • Tagging Requirement: Every post, story, or video uploaded to social media must include an official tag of Sereia’s account (@sereiaofficial) and relevant hashtags provided by the brand. Failure to include proper tags may result in disqualification from the affiliate program.

5. Content Ownership and Usage

  • By participating in the affiliate program, affiliates grant Sereia a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free, perpetual license to use, modify, distribute, and publicly display any content produced under the affiliate program, including but not limited to images, videos, and written content.
  • Sereia may use this content for marketing, advertising, and promotional purposes without additional compensation.

6. Termination

  • Sereia reserves the right to terminate an affiliate's participation in the program at any time if the affiliate violates these terms.
  • Affiliates may terminate their participation by providing written notice to Sereia.
  • Upon termination, any outstanding commissions that have not met the payment threshold will be forfeited.

7. Modification of Terms

Sereia reserves the right to modify these terms and conditions at any time. Affiliates will be notified of significant changes, and continued participation in the program constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

By joining the Sereia Affiliate Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms and Conditions.
